prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The Conservatives’ plan is to secure Britain’s future by sticking with the proven approach that has brought inflation down, real wages up, growth back—and lower taxes. We reject Labour’s path of higher taxes, unfunded spending, weaker borders and drifting standards. Choose lower immigration, lower taxes and protected pensions.

Stronger economy and lower taxes
- Halve employee National Insurance to 6% by April 2027; abolish the main rate of self‑employed NI next Parliament; no rises in income tax or VAT.
- Triple Lock Plus: both State Pension and pensioners’ tax‑free allowance rise by the highest of earnings, inflation or 2.5%.
- 30 hours of free childcare from 9 months; fairer Child Benefit on a household basis (taper from £120,000).
- Clamp down on avoidance/evasion (£6bn a year); cut bureaucracy, return the Civil Service to pre‑pandemic size, curb wasteful EDI spend.
- Back business: keep corporation tax, full expensing, a 10‑point SME plan, faster planning and £36bn for local transport. Lead in AI/R&D (£22bn/yr) and advanced manufacturing.

Opportunity for the next generation
- Modern National Service at 18: paid competitive military placements or structured civic service.
- 100,000 high‑quality apprenticeships funded by closing poor‑value university courses.
- Restore discipline and standards: ban phones in school; Advanced British Standard to end the academic/technical divide; parental transparency on sensitive teaching; expand SEN places.

Borders, defence and national security
- Legal cap on migration that falls each year; higher salary thresholds; health checks and higher charges for visa holders; no return to free movement.
- Stop the boats: monthly Rwanda flights; end legal game‑playing; more returns deals; rewrite asylum rules for the mass‑migration era.
- Defence to 2.5% of GDP by 2030; invest in munitions, innovation and veterans; unwavering support for Ukraine and Trident.

World‑class NHS and safer communities
- NHS funding up above inflation each year; 92,000 more nurses and 28,000 more doctors; Pharmacy First, 250 GP surgeries, 50 Community Diagnostic Centres.
- Technology‑driven productivity plan (£3.4bn), patient choice, Martha’s Rule; dental recovery; women’s health plan; implement the Cass Review.
- Define sex in law as biological sex to protect single‑sex spaces and fairness in sport.
- 8,000 more neighbourhood police; hotspot policing; Martyn’s Law; tougher sentences for violent/sexual crime and domestic murders; decisive action against extremism and disruptive protests; protect Jewish and Muslim communities.

Pragmatic, affordable net zero and energy security
- Annual North Sea licensing and new gas to keep the lights on; treble offshore wind; deliver CCS clusters; expand nuclear (approve two SMR fleets; progress Wylfa).
- Green Industries Growth Accelerator; import carbon pricing by 2027.
- No new green levies; maintain the price cap; PumpWatch; £6bn for home efficiency and universal vouchers; support solar in the right places; retain fracking moratorium.

Homes, drivers and local pride
- Build 1.6m homes; scrap EU nutrient‑neutrality barriers (with mitigation fees); fast‑track brownfield; densify cities; protect the Green Belt.
- Permanently lift FTB Stamp Duty threshold to £425,000; new Help to Buy; extend Mortgage Guarantee; complete leasehold reform; fair renters’ reform.
- Back drivers: ban road pricing, reverse London ULEZ expansion, require local referendums for 20mph/LTNs; extend £2 bus fare cap.

Backing farmers, fisheries, the Union and Brexit freedoms
- Increase UK‑wide farming budget by £1bn (inflation‑proofed); legal food security target; fast‑track farm infrastructure; replicate the £100m UK Seafood Fund.
- Protect the Union and internal market; invest across Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland.
- Seize Brexit: CPTPP membership, India/GCC deals, tough TCA stance, ongoing EU law reform and red‑tape cuts.

For a secure, confident, opportunity‑rich Britain—vote Conservative.
